newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-, 6-mo T-bills up, 9-mo yields down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-, 6-mo T-bills up, 9-mo yields down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three- and six-month treasury bills rose and nine-month yields slipped from the last sale on March 14, while the auction of 12-month bills was cancelled, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Three-month bills edged up to 24.24 percent from 24.20 percent, six-month bills rose to 30.07 percent from 29.99 percent, and nine-month bills eased to 32.74 percent from 32.93 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 6.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Amount sold 2.89 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.73 million UAH 9.43 million UAH
The central bank sold 28,934 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 6,203 were competitive and 22,731 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 19.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.80 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Amount sold 4.60 million UAH 12.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.00 million UAH 10.44 million UAH
The central bank sold 46,014 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 22,135 were competitive and 23,879 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 19.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 25.00 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Amount sold 6.24 million UAH 31.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.01 million UAH 24.87 million UAH
The central bank sold 62,411 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 44,139 were competitive and 18,272 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for March 19.
The 12-month bill auction was cancelled without explanation.
